# Mailbox Plus
> Pack & ship, printing, mailbox rentals, and business services in Concord Township, Ohio. UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL at one counter.

## Business Info

- **Business Name:** Mailbox Plus
- **Tagline:** Shipping shouldn't cost you an hour.
- **Description:** Community-focused pack & ship retail store in Concord Township, Ohio. FedEx, UPS, USPS shipping, mailbox rentals, printing, and fingerprinting services.
- **Location:** 7554 Fredle Drive, Concord Township, OH 44077
- **Phone:** 440-709-1946
- **Email:** help@mailboxplusohio.com
- **Hours:**
  - Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
  - Saturday: 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  - Sunday: Closed
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/Rs1NQkR6gRrtxAq37
- **Rating:** 5.0 stars (32 reviews)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Opened:** May 5, 2025
- **Social:**
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mailboxplusohio
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mailboxplusohio
  - Nextdoor: https://nextdoor.com/pages/mailbox-plus-concord-township-oh
- **Areas Served:** Concord Township, Mentor, Painesville, Eastlake, Lake County, and surrounding Northeast Ohio communities.

### Mailbox Pricing
- Small Mailbox: $35/month ($420/year prepaid)
- Large Mailbox: $50/month ($600/year prepaid)
- Key Deposit: $5 (refundable)
- Additional Package Overage: $5
- 30-day risk-free trial. Month-to-month, no annual contract.
- Receive packages from all 4 carriers (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL). Notification within 4 hours.

## Key Differentiators

- **Multi-carrier comparison:** We quote UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL side-by-side — you pick the cheapest or fastest. Franchises can only sell one.
- **Professional packing:** Carrier-compliant materials, double-wall boxes, 2-inch acrylic tape, bubble wrap — not newspaper.
- **All 4 carriers:** Authorized FedEx ShipCenter, UPS Authorized Shipper Outlet, USPS provider, and DHL Service Point.
- **Free package drop-offs:** Bring any pre-labeled package from any carrier. No charge. Receipt provided.
- **Declared-value insurance:** Third-party insurance through Marsh for items worth more than the carrier's $100 default liability.
- **Porch theft protection:** Private mailbox means packages go to our counter, not your doorstep. We sign for all deliveries.
- **Walk-in notary:** $5 per signature. No appointment needed. Certified notary on staff during all hours.
